race.description: Extreme Warrior At Rosemont Stud Mdn Plate
race.comment: ROYAL DUCK (8) looks hard to beat. Her debut at Bendigo was very good, in the market and going down the barest of margins to a handy one, striking some interference late as well. She should have learnt plenty from that run and is nicely equipped to go one better. SAINT FOX (11) is a colt by Frankel on debut for the Begg yard. He's certainly bred to get much further than 1200m but has won a jumpout and warrants plenty of respect. SCAROLE (12) is an Ole Kirk colt on debut for the Maher yard who can be hitting the line, while MYSTIC RAPTURE (7) did enough fresh behind a handy one and can improve from an ideal draw.
